plugins.name: checkout-guard
plugins.description: Warns when another Claude session shares this git checkout and blocks git commands that would move the tree under it

plugins.name: pr-session
plugins.description: Names a session pr-<repo>-<number> after the first PR it mentions, and adds /handoff and /resume-handoff

plugins.name: session-info
plugins.description: Shows the git repo and branch, kubectl context, model, and effort at the end of the hint line under the prompt
